Done. Summary of what I did:

**Remediation:**
1. Confirmed the latest release, **v2.3.1**, was failing health checks in production (~18% error rate across us-east, us-west, and eu-west), and identified **v2.3.0** as the most recent healthy production release.
2. Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all regions. The first attempt partially failed (only us-east completed due to an orchestrator error); a retry completed us-west and eu-west.
3. Verified post-rollback: **v2.3.0 is running in all three regions, healthy, with the error rate down to 0.2%.**

**Incident:**
- Opened **INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api page-on-call, titled "checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0." It documents the failure, the rollback sequence (including the partial-then-retry), the verified recovery, and notes that the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure is still under investigation. (The creation call timed out after the incident was successfully created, so no duplicate was filed.)

Note: v2.3.1 remains unhealthy and unresolved — a fix will need to be redeployed (with change-manager approval if appropriate) once the root cause is identified.
